create_ensemble_predict_interval: create an ensemble prediction interval object with a forecasting model, time series data, and block parameters
get_projection_forecast: get a forecast projection with confidence intervals for a specified number of future steps
get_fcst_band_with_level: get the forecast band with a custom confidence level after running get_projection first
calculate_mean_confidence_interval: calculate the mean, lower, and upper bounds of a confidence interval from numpy array data
plot_pi_comparison: plot a comparison chart of historical data, predicted values, and prediction interval bands
